name: PinPoint by Avalanche
changelog: 2.1.2 — PinPoint now lives at pinpoint.avalanchegr.com. 2.1.1 — The PinPoint logo. 2.1.0 — Avalanche Markup is now PinPoint. Pins find their element far more reliably after the page changes (new fingerprint matching plus live re-positioning when layout shifts). AI assistants can now reply to and resolve items from an export. 2.0.0 — Avalanche Markup 2.0: accounts and site ownership, the customer dashboard and plans, per-site bridge secrets, and a refreshed Avalanche look. After updating, add AVALANCHE_MARKUP_PROJECT_SECRET to wp-config.php — Settings → Avalanche Markup shows where to find it.
